name: BizyPop Loyalty Platform
summary: Tenant-aware data and deployment workflows for a loyalty SaaS.
description: Backend and infrastructure work on BizyPop, a multi-tenant loyalty platform. The work includes business-user relationships, geographic reference data, and deployment routines that preserve uploaded files.
technologies: ASP.NET Core, .NET 8 / .NET 9, EF Core, SQL Server, rsync
challenge: Businesses can have multiple users, and users can belong to multiple businesses. Deployments must also protect uploaded files while updating the application.
approach: Represent business-user membership with an explicit many-to-many schema and resolve relationships through explicit queries. Maintain city and ZIP-code reference data, and use rsync deployments to preserve wwwroot/uploads.
features: Explicit EF Core joins and DTO projections
